text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
As the year drew near its end, and 
everyone was getting fairly accustomed to 
growing vegetables—

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Everyo~ne! Let's take a short break~!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Fufufu. The veggies are growing better and 
better by the day, aren't they~!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Absolutely! Do you know how many times I 
almost took a bite while working 
today...?!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
I... understand how you feel, though. 
Ehehe.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Still, after putting all that effort into 
growing them, I really ought to cook them 
up delicious.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Hahaha. Well, while Spe and Rice are still 
holding back, here's a suggestion.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
How about we do that tasting session we 
talked about earlier? We'll pick out the 
best of the veggies we grew and cook 
together!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
"Whatever dishes each of us felt like 
eating. What do you think?"

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Whoa, I will, I definitely will!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
If we try out all sorts of things, we 
might even come up with a new recipe!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
All right, I'm gonna make everything I can 
think of! You can never have too much 
buono, after all!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Mmmgh... My stomach is roaring! Bring on 
any dish you've got~!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Alright! Let's just give it a shot for 
now!
